title: Grateful Dead Live at Berkeley Community Theatre on 1972-08-25
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> VXPocket v2 -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Pristine Betty‑board sound captures a high‑energy August 25 1972 show with standout Truckin’→Other One and superb Friend of the Devil performances.
ai_review.review: The recording is an exceptionally clear Betty board mix, praised for its full balance, crisp vocals and only occasional crackle. Musically the concert shines with a powerful Truckin’ → The Other One sequence, a tight, rock‑n‑roll take on Friend of the Devil, and immaculate renditions of Black Peter and Cold Rain and Snow, despite minor slip-ups like a lyric miss on Bertha.

ai_rating.rationale: The vast majority of reviews (17 out of 19) rate the release 4‑5 stars and highlight both superb soundboard quality and an outstanding performance, yielding a high combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as pristine, full, balanced with great stereo separation; minor crackles noted but overall crisp. Mix praised for clear vocals and Bear’s masterful front‑of‑house balance.

poor_songs: Playing in the Band (Donna's contribution noted as a blemish)
show_quality.setlist_flow: A dark, powerful first set followed by an intense second set featuring a long Truckin'→Other One jam and tight, rock‑driven numbers; overall flow praised for composure, focus, and extended improvisational space.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Top‑form guitar work with non‑stock licks and a crystal‑clear vocal presence; described as ‘singing into the ear.’
band_member_comments.Phil: Prominent bass solo (2½ min after Truckin'), powerful “bass bombs,” and an octave effect heard throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Bob: Cool, prominently mixed guitar on Friend of the Devil, highlighted as a rare treat.
